themes_detail.label: Cannabis Retailer Complaint Surge
themes_detail.summary: Complaints about cannabis retailers spiked to 9 this week versus a baseline of 0.6 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 1340% increase (z-score: 12.03)—suggesting either rapid illegal retail expansion or enforcement action in Greenwich Village/SoHo this week.
evidence: 9 cannabis retailer complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1340% spike)
Z-score of 12.03 indicates statistical anomaly of highest order
No prior news coverage or community board discussion yet, suggesting this may be breaking
reporting_angles: Are unlicensed cannabis shops opening rapidly in the neighborhood? Interview CBD 102 residents and NYPD about enforcement
What triggered the sudden spike—new retail openings, enforcement sweep, or community complaints? Obtain 311 complaint details to map locations

themes_detail.label: For-Hire Vehicle Complaints Double
themes_detail.summary: For-hire vehicle complaints (Ubers, Lyft, etc.) jumped to 61 this week from a baseline of 26.8 per week—a 128% spike (z-score: 4.6)—indicating acute traffic, congestion, or driver behavior issues in a neighborhood already logging 1,175 illegal parking complaints.
evidence: 61 for-hire vehicle complaints THIS WEEK vs. 26.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (128% increase)
Z-score of 4.6 indicates high statistical significance
Converges with Traffic complaints spike (7 this week vs. 1.0 avg, +600%) suggesting linked congestion issue
Illegal Parking already the highest-volume complaint category (1,175 over 90 days)
reporting_angles: Has Uber/Lyft surge pricing or holiday travel driven more vehicles into the neighborhood? Contact platforms for surge data
Are specific neighborhoods or hours generating clusters of complaints? Map 311 data to identify hotspots and interview affected residents

themes_detail.label: Traffic Congestion Spike
themes_detail.summary: Traffic complaints increased to 7 this week versus a baseline of 1.0 per week—a 600% surge (z-score: 6.0)—coinciding with for-hire vehicle complaint doubling, suggesting a coordinated congestion event or major traffic disruption in Greenwich Village/SoHo this week.
evidence: 7 traffic complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (600% increase)
Z-score of 6.0 indicates high statistical significance
Overlaps temporally with For-Hire Vehicle Complaint spike (61 this week vs. 26.8 avg)
Streets already strained: 611 street condition complaints over 90 days
reporting_angles: Has a major street closure, event, or construction project begun this week? Check DOT and event calendars
Are rush hours now impassable? Interview residents and local business owners about commute impacts

themes_detail.label: Consumer Complaints Triple
themes_detail.summary: Consumer complaints jumped to 19 this week from a baseline of 7.8 per week—a 145% increase (z-score: 5.5)—suggesting emerging retail fraud, price gouging, or deceptive business practices in the neighborhood this week.
evidence: 19 consumer complaints THIS WEEK vs. 7.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (145% increase)
Z-score of 5.5 indicates strong statistical anomaly
Converges with Food Establishment spike (18 complaints last week vs. 10.6 avg, +69%), suggesting possible food/beverage retail issues
reporting_angles: What types of consumer complaints are being filed? Obtain 311 complaint summaries to identify patterns (pricing, quality, deception)
Are particular retailers or neighborhoods seeing clusters? Interview affected consumers and DCA about enforcement actions

themes_detail.label: Environmental Stress Signals
themes_detail.summary: Three environment-related 311 spikes appeared this week: dead/dying trees (4 complaints vs. 0.5 avg, +700%), dead animals (3 last week vs. 0.6 avg, +380%), and litter basket requests (4 vs. 0.6 avg, +540%)—suggesting environmental degradation or sanitation failure across the district.
evidence: Dead/Dying Tree: 4 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly average (700% spike, z-score: 4.95)
Dead Animal: 3 complaints last week vs. 0.6 weekly average (380% spike, z-score: 4.91)
Litter Basket Request: 4 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly average (540% spike, z-score: 4.85)
Community board budget requests include repeated demands for forestry services and sanitation equipment—unmet needs surfacing now
reporting_angles: Has the city delayed street tree maintenance or sanitation collection? Check DOE/DSNY schedules for service disruptions
Are specific neighborhoods seeing concentrated environmental issues? Map complaints and interview residents about visible decay
